integrity: Infinite integral homotopy theorem proved by elementary face decomposition and mapping cones. Finite mod-two enumeration is supplemental; a genuinely independent scientific audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Two complete cliques with exactly one retained common edge, triangle-free vertex-set functor, a,b>=2; no claim about general clique sums or equivariant actions.
title: An integral mixed-dimensional wedge for triangle-free complexes of edge-glued cliques
